# Axiom Works AgentReader

> Pay-per-call tools for AI agents. No API keys: x402 (HTTP 402) + USDC on Base (eip155:8453), payTo 0x88b1c747c33A5868A34057D8C57318E5602b3ff6.
> Free truncated samples: https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/samples/{read|company|uk-company|uk-company-lite|convert|uk-charity|uk-charity-full} (8/IP/day). Or add &preview=1 on paid GETs (same limit).

## When to use which (pick one)

| Need | Endpoint | Price | Why ours |
|---|---|---|---|
| Page → Markdown | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/read?url= | $0.002 | Readability + metadata JSON, not raw HTML |
| Links only | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/links?url= | $0.001 | Cheaper than /read |
| Domain health | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/check?domain= | $0.001 | DNS/TLS/MX/SPF/DMARC + score |
| Website company research | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/company?domain= | $0.25 | Sourced tech/contacts/DNS/RDAP/news (no LLM fiction) |
| UK CH full DD | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/uk-company?number=|name= | $0.50 | Official API: officers/PSC/filings/charges/insolvency + red flags |
| UK CH cheap snapshot | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/uk-company-lite?number=|name= | $0.05 | Status + compliance flags; upsell full pack |
| Website + UK DD bundle | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/company-full?domain= | $0.65 | $0.10 cheaper than $0.25+$0.50 when UK detected |
| PDF/DOCX → text | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/convert?url= | $0.03 | Structured markdown/text for RAG |
| EVM wallet balances | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/wallet?address=&chain=base | $0.003 | Native + 7 stablecoins/majors, 5 chains, one call |
| Tx / payment receipt | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/tx?hash=&chain=base | $0.003 | Status, confirmations, fee, decoded USDC transfers |
| Token due diligence | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/token-check?address=&chain=base | $0.01 | Owner/proxy/supply + DEX liquidity + risk flags |
| ENS name ⇄ address | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/ens?name=vitalik.eth | $0.002 | Forward + text records, or verified reverse |
| Token metadata | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/token?address=&chain=base | $0.001 | name/symbol/decimals/supply only |
| ERC20 allowance | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/allowance?token=&owner=&spender= | $0.002 | Unlimited flag + spendable now |
| Contract / address info | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/contract?address=&chain=base | $0.003 | Proxy impl, clone, 7702, standards, Sourcify name |
| Gas / fees now | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/gas?chain=base | $0.001 | EIP-1559 suggestion + USD cost estimates |
| Block by number or time | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/block?timestamp=2026-01-01 | $0.001 | Timestamp → block search |
| NFT owner + metadata | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/nft?contract=&token_id= | $0.002 | IPFS/Arweave resolved JSON |

| UK house prices | https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/uk-property?postcode= | $0.01 | HM Land Registry Price Paid near postcode |

| Hourly change alerts | POST https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/monitor | $1.00/30d | Webhook on change; GET /monitor/:id free |

## Free
- https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/samples/:kind — cached truncated real examples + upsell
- https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/monitor/:id — monitor status · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/hooks/sink — webhook test sink (POST)
- https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/llms.txt · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/openapi.json · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/.well-known/x402 · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/.well-known/agent.json · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/mcp · https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/health

## Pay
HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402 v2). Retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (@x402/fetch, x402-axios). MCP: https://api.axiomworks.co.uk/mcp
